summary: Pair with a computer to mirror a terminal session on e-ink.
release_notes: See whether the computer is connected, waiting or reconnecting, stop sharing from the laptop, and start a terminal or a system monitor from a named preset instead of typing a command.

steps.text: Run kobo stream init on the computer, install its stream trust root on the Kobo, then start kobo stream.

user: Somebody who wants a quiet e-ink terminal for their computer.
job: Pair with your computer and mirror a terminal session on e-ink.
offline: Nothing works without the pairing; the network is the job.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; re-pairing takes a moment

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to carry the terminal session from your computer

non_goals: It does not run programs on the reader itself.
It does not keep scrollback after a session ends.
